thread:
maya: FYI we flipped on strict fncall schema validation + routing coalescer on the canary and immediately saw validation rejects spike (~3x) and fallback rate to degenerate model doubled. Looks like an interaction with prefix cache and coalescing.
liam: Oof. Which settings changed together? coalescer debounce + strict validator? that combo can merge slightly different payloads and create invalid shapes.
sasha: We set debounce_ms=200 and coalescing=true in the flag. Telemetry shows rejects mostly `missing_required_field` and `schema_mismatch`.
maya: Logs indicate many near-duplicate requests that were collapsed by the coalescer; merged payload lost some optional fields in snapshot.
kevin: So two vectors: coalescer merging variant shapes, then validator enforcing strict required fields. Options: (A) reduce debounce to 50ms, (B) set validator to soft-fail nullable/missing optional, (C) make coalescer keep per-request snapshots for validator.
anne: For safe rollouts we should never enable both features in one canary flip. Let's rollback coalescing for now and re-run debounce-only.
liam: Also we need to fix billing metrics: currently fallback->degen traffic is still attributed to primary model in cost dashboards which inflates per-model cost. We should add routing attribution info to telemetry.
sasha: I propose adding tags on fncall events: `invoke_path`, `fallback_reason`, and `route_coalesced`. That lets dashboards slice cost and fallback rates properly.
kevin: Agreed. Also add a `validation.sample_id` to link to sampled payload artifacts instead of storing raw bodies. Keep artifact store TTL short.
maya: Example telemetry event we'd emit: 

```
{"metric":"fncall.invoke","tags":["model=gpt-x","invoke_path=coalescer->validator->serve","fallback_reason=schema_mismatch","route_coalesced=true"],"sample_id":"smp_abc123"}
```
liam: Dashboard asks: stacked bar for `fncall.validation.rejects` by `fallback_reason`; time series for `routing.debounce_hit_rate`; latency histogram annotated when fallback occurred; and cost-per-invoke grouped by `invoke_path`.
sasha: Note: we must not persist full request content in telemetry. Use a short SHA to map to sampled artifact in secure store and redact customer data.
anne: Console UX: add a rollup tile that shows by `invoke_path` the fallback %, p50/p95 latency, and avg cost. For customers with high fallback rates show recommended remediation (e.g., toggle debounce down or enable soft-validate).
kevin: Implementation plan: 1) rollback coalescing on canary now; 2) split rollout flags into `routing.debounce_ms` and `validator.strict_mode`; 3) add telemetry tags and `sample_id`; 4) build dashboard panels; 5) gated enable of `coalescer.preserve_snapshots` behind flag.
maya: I'll coordinate the rollout and change flags. Please don't flip both at once.
liam: I'll own the telemetry PR to add `invoke_path`, `fallback_reason`, `route_coalesced`, and `validation.sample_id`. Will include server-side sampling for validator errors to avoid noise.
sasha: I'll file the dashboard ticket, mock panels, and update runbook language about sampling and artifact TTL.
kevin: I'll work on coalescer patch to optionally preserve original request snapshots and expose `coalescer.preserve_snapshots` behind a flag. Will try to keep perf impact minimal.
anne: Deploy-bot can you schedule rollback of the coalescer flag on prod-canary?
deploy-bot: scheduled rollback: flag `coalescer.enabled` -> false on prod-canary at 2024-11-12T15:12:00Z. CI green. Will post once complete.
maya: Thanks all. After rollback we'll run debounce-only at 10% canary for 24h, inspect telemetry. If rejects still high we'll move validator to soft mode with sampling.
liam: Also please make sure fallback attribution appears in cost dashboards before we re-enable strict validator. Otherwise noise will hide true cost signals.
sasha: Will add `fncall.validation.sample_id` mapping docs and create small artifact store with TTL=7d and RBAC.
kevin: Plan LGTM. +1 on staged rollout and telemetry-first approach.
anne: Runbook update: add check "if fallback_rate > 1% over 1h -> pause rollout and revert validator".
maya: Assignments: maya (rollout), liam (telemetry PR & metric tags), sasha (dashboards + runbook + artifacts), kevin (coalescer snapshot patch). We'll link PRs in this thread. :thumbsup:
